edits.before: Bravado-weave the trades — the empowered autos refund cooldowns; the loop is the lane.
edits.after: His double-bomb Time Bomb stun-and-burst punishes your dashless kit before you can close.

edits.before: Q-charges bank heals: the gemstone economy opens.
edits.after: His two-bomb combo chunks you; no answer yet.

edits.before: Full kit: W-link the carry and the E stuns from two bodies — the double angle is the trap.
edits.after: He keeps kiting and stunning your walk-ups with Time Bomb plus his E speed boost.

edits.before: Cosmic Radiance online — dives on your duo meet a scheduled invulnerability.
edits.after: Your R makes all-ins survivable — bait Chronoshift or focus through it.

edits.before: First item: the stuns chain and the heals compound.
edits.after: W-stun burst finally beats his double-bomb rotation.

edits.before: Late Taric un-kills teamfights: R the dive, link the carry, and stun the formation twice per rotation.

edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Cosmic Radiance banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Zilean Chronoshift (R, 120/90/60s CD): matchup-defining — the revive undoes your kill; force it early or swap focus when it glows. - Keep R Cosmic Radiance banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Dive when both Time Bombs are down — his E speed boost only helps him flee, not survive the all-in.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Linking through a fresh double-bomb — the second Q detonates early and stuns your own commit.
